description: Lists every BaseEdge Labs trading strategy for TradingView: its strategy_id, name, page on baseedgelabs.ai, whether it is free or paid, how many presets it has and, when signed in, whether this account holds a license for it. The response is small: one short row per strategy, no presets. It is the starting point for what exists; list_presets returns the presets themselves. Takes no inputs. Read-only.
name: list_strategies
title: List strategies
